title: CodeChallenge: Critical points in Python, part 1

cues.en: The goal of this code challenge is to explore critical points in Python, both in NumPy and in senpai,
cues.zh: 這次程式挑戰的目標，是在 Python 中，用 NumPy 和 SymPy 探索臨界點，

cues.en: and you will learn by the end of this code challenge that getting critical points in Python is not so trivial.
cues.zh: 到最後你會發現，用 Python 求臨界點，沒那麼簡單。

cues.en: It requires a little bit of creativity regardless of whether you are using numpy or simply.
cues.zh: 不管用 NumPy 還是 SymPy，都需要一點創意。

cues.en: So there's going to be three exercises in this code challenge.
cues.zh: 這次程式挑戰會有三個練習。

cues.en: The first one is entirely in numpy and I think that will take the longest.
cues.zh: 第一個完全用 NumPy，我想會花最久。

cues.en: So I'll probably break the video after that first exercise and then the second two will be in simply.
cues.zh: 所以第一題後可能先切一支影片，另外兩題再用 SymPy。

cues.en: So let's begin with Exercise one.
cues.zh: 先看練習一。

cues.en: The goal is going to be to find the critical points of this function here, X squared plus x cubed.
cues.zh: 目標是找這個函數 x²+x³ 的臨界點。
